subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 05, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 05, 2026**

**Breaking News: Bazzite 45 Released!**

We're excited to announce that Bazzite 45 has been released! This new version brings a host of improvements and bug fixes to our beloved image editor. According to the Bazzite community, this release is a major update that addresses several issues and adds new features. You can read more about the changes in the official Bazzite forum thread.

**Community News**

* Our community has been hard at work, with several new commits and updates to our projects. We're proud of the progress being made and encourage everyone to get involved and contribute to the AcreetionOS ecosystem.
* We've also seen an increase in activity on our Discord server, with many users discussing the latest developments and sharing their experiences with AcreetionOS.

**Practical Tip: Using AcreetionSurf**

AcreetionSurf is a powerful tool for browsing the web privately and securely. To use it, simply install the package and run the command `acreetion-surf` in your terminal. You can then access the web interface by navigating to `http://localhost:8080` in your web browser. AcreetionSurf uses the Tor network to anonymize your browsing activity, making it a great option for users who want to maintain their online privacy.

That's all for this week's newsletter. We're excited to see what the future holds for AcreetionOS and our community. Stay tuned for more updates and news from the world of AcreetionOS!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
